H5699.def: something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle

H5700.def: Eglon, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king
senses: 1) king of Moab who oppressed the children of Israel for 18 years before he was killed by the judge Ehud
2) a royal city in Canaan that opposed the conquest; located in the low lands of Judah
1) (Niphal) to shut oneself in or off or up

H5703.def: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H5703.kjv: eternity, ever(-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, [phrase] world without end.

H5704.def: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
senses: 1) as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as
1a1) as far as, up to, even to
1c1) even to, until, unto, till, during, end
1d1) even to, to the degree of, even like
2) until, while, to the point that, so that even
H5704.deriv: properly, the same as {H5703} (used as a preposition, adverb or conjunction; especially with a preposition);
H5704.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

H5705.def: {as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)}
senses: 1) even to, until, up to, during
2) until, up to the time that, ere that
H5705.kjv: [idiom] and, at, for, (hither-) to, on till, (un-) to, until, within.

H5706.deriv: the same as {H5703} in the sense of the aim of an attack;

H5707.def: concretely, a witness; abstractly, testimony; specifically, a recorder, i.e. prince

H5708.def: the menstrual flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) soiling
senses: 1a) filthy rag, stained garment (fig. of best deeds of guilty people)

H5709.def: {to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon)}

H5710.def: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon)
senses: 1) to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove
H5710.kjv: adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.

H5711.def: Adah, the name of two women
senses: 1) the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal
2) a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz

H5712.def: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)
H5712.deriv: feminine of {H5707} in the original sense of fixture;
H5712.kjv: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare {H5713}.

senses: 1a) always plural and always of laws as divine testimonies
H5713.deriv: feminine of {H5707} in its techn. sense;

H5714.def: Iddo (or Iddi), the name of five Israelites
senses: 1) father of Abinadab, an officer of Solomon
3) a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah
4) a priest in the time of Nehemiah
5) a seer in the time of king Jeroboam of the northern kingdom of Israel
6) son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh in the time of David
7) a chief of the temple slaves who assembled at Casiphia at the time of the 2nd caravan from Babylon

H5716.def: finery; generally an outfit; specifically, a headstall

H5717.def: Adiel, the name of three Israelites
senses: 1) a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
3) ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David

H5718.def: Adajah, the name of eight Israelites
senses: 1) maternal grandfather of king Josiah of Judah and native of Boscath in the lowlands of Judah
2) a Gershonite Levite and ancestor of Asaph

H5720.def: Adin, the name of two Israelites

1) a chief of the Reubenites, and a captain of David

senses: 1) a town in the lowland of Judah

H5726.def: an Adullamite or native of Adullam

senses: 1) the first habitat of man after the creation; site unknown

H5733.def: Adna, the name of two Israelites

senses: 1) a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag
2) a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of Jehoshaphat
1) one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah

H5737.def: to arrange as a battle, a vineyard (to hoe); hence, to muster and so to miss (or find wanting)

senses: 1) a Benjamite, son of Beriah, chief of the inhabitants of Aijalon

H5740.def: Eder, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine
senses: 1) a Merarite Levite in the time of David
2) a town in the extreme south of Judah on the border of Edom; site unknown

H5742.deriv: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

1) a son of Joktan and the founder of an Arab tribe

senses: 1) to return, repeat, go about, do again
1a) (Piel) to surround, go round and round
2a) (Qal) to bear witness, say again and again
2b2) to cause to testify, take or call as witness, invoke
2b3) to protest, affirm solemnly, warn, exhort or enjoin solemnly, admonish, charge
H5749.kjv: admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.
